host_observation.observation_note: Host facts are engineering observations only and contain no corpus evidence.

stage_inventory.rule: Two qualified humans establish source language before alignment. Any future Whisper language probability is advisory discrepancy evidence only and cannot override a human label.

stage_inventory.fixed_role: Quarantined source-language text proposal only; task=transcribe; no translation, prompt, hotwords, external vocabulary, or machine-only acceptance.
stage_inventory.next_precondition: After ChildLens G1 and release binding pass, acquire verified code and weights into an isolated restricted instrument cache under a separately logged action.

stage_inventory.environment_feasibility: Python 3.10.20 is present and version-compatible, but no environment, package, aligner, or weight is installed.
stage_inventory.route_rule: Pin a language-specific aligner only after genuine human language identification and before any alignment. Unsupported, mixed, or undecidable language routes use manual utterance timing.

stage_inventory.fallback: Language-matched humans directly label all five roles; all G4 timing/role validation items are independently double coded.

stage_inventory.selection_rule: Pilot and annotation items remain metadata/hash selected; no ASR word, detector, visual salience, or apparent grounding quality may select content.
stage_inventory.automation_rule: No pretrained detector, tracker, temporal ranker, embedding, or external label vocabulary is approved or locally pinned in this preflight.
stage_inventory.human_requirement: Humans judge visible object/action candidates, null, ambiguity, unusability, and the utterance-to-nearest-visible-candidate lag.

stage_inventory.minimal_fallback: Version-pinned ffplay for local playback plus restricted SQLite entry; no remote web service.

stage_inventory.rule: Before receiving human labels, freeze and unit-test either exact package pins or a reviewed local implementation for token/grapheme error, macro-F1, boundary error, cluster-aware uncertainty, and referential agreement. Do not choose an estimator after seeing agreement or lexical quality.

local_absence_checks.interpretation: The upstream pins are an acquisition specification only. No runnable ASR, alignment, VAD, diarization, voice-type, or reliability environment exists locally.

human_validation_packet_requirements.codex_human_judgment_policy: Codex may build, blind, validate structure, and aggregate the packet, but it cannot count as a human auditory, linguistic, speaker-role, or visible-referent annotator.

minimum_people.adjudicator: A qualified human not substitutable by an instrument; may be one of the qualified people only after independent labels are locked.

qualifications: Source-language competence documented before exposure to machine proposals
Training on the frozen role and referential ontologies using non-ChildLens practice material or terms-permitted internal training items
Ability to hear child versus other-person speech and code overlap/uncertainty without identity inference
Referential coders trained to retain null, ambiguous, undecidable, and unusable cases

restricted_packet_layers.content: Opaque item key, selected local media window, waveform/playback controls, language label, utterance onset/offset, intelligibility and overlap flags
At least the frozen 20 percent ASR-hidden subset; independent source-language verbatim text, timing, and frozen speaker role
Machine proposal only if its software and corpus permissions pass; otherwise blank manual entry; every accepted text/timing/role field receives an explicit human disposition
Frozen +/-5 second window, visible object/action candidate status, null/ambiguity/unusable status, candidate count, nearest visible-candidate boundary, confidence and notes
restricted_packet_layers.double_code: At least 20 percent, stratified by participant and speech/activity stratum

human_validation_packet_requirements.privacy: Packet, media, text, paths, identifiers, exact times, item labels, and disagreements remain in the untracked restricted quarantine. Only terms-permitted, nonidentifying, cell-suppressed aggregates and protocol/digest receipts may leave.

instrument_to_learner_firewall.tokenizer_rule: A future tokenizer is initialized from scratch using only authorized, fully human-dispositioned ChildLens-local text. No instrument tokenizer or vocabulary supplies tokens or initialization.
instrument_to_learner_firewall.ancestry_rule: External instruments remain measurement-process ancestors recorded in receipts but never scientific learner ancestors. Human-assisted text is admissible only under the proposed amendment, full human disposition, and an ASR-hidden bias subset; the human-only fallback has the cleanest ancestry.

public_primary_metadata_receipts.observed: version 1.2.1, MIT metadata, wheel SHA-256 and Python >=3.9
version 3.8.5, BSD-2-Clause metadata, wheel SHA-256 and Python >=3.10,<3.14
immutable revision, public/ungated status, MIT model-card metadata
multilingual capability plus explicit language, accent, dialect and hallucination limitations
public/ungated repository with no license metadata
CC-BY-4.0 metadata plus required user acceptance and contact-information sharing
FFmpeg licensing depends on build options; the observed local build enables GPL and version3
loopback address, CORS, XSRF, file-watcher, static-serving and usage-statistics controls

required_next_actions_before_restricted_: Coordinator establishes ChildLens G1 separately for local decode, restricted derivatives, fixed local instruments, retention/deletion, and aggregate export.
Coordinator binds the release and selects the frozen content-blind pilot before any content tool runs.
Create an isolated Python 3.10 instrument environment and acquire only hash-verified, license-reviewed ASR/alignment artifacts after authorization; keep network disabled during inference.
Freeze the human-established language route and any language-specific aligner before alignment, or use manual utterance timing.
Do not acquire or execute VTC or pyannote under current evidence; use direct human role coding.
Implement and sentinel-test the loopback-only UI in the restricted namespace with telemetry disabled and logs redacted.
Freeze and unit-test reliability/error metric implementations before any human packet is scored.
Populate a blinded packet and obtain genuine language-matched human annotation; pause rather than attributing human reliability to Codex or a model.
workstream_conclusion: This preflight does not issue or alter a ChildLens feasibility decision. It establishes a locally pinned decode and UI base, a fully specified human-only fallback, and a strict instrument firewall; automated ASR/alignment remain upstream-pinned but absent, and automated speaker-role tools remain blocked.
